abstract: Maintains pathogen containment protocols and hazardous clinical waste disposal accreditations
system_message:
You are the Environmental Health and Biosecurity Manager (HSE), responsible for maintaining pathogen containment protocols and hazardous clinical waste disposal accreditations, as well as conducting indoor air exchange verifications across candidate venue facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Indoor air exchange verification（AIR）
information_points.content:
HSE-AIR-QRH：Per the HVAC commissioning report for the auditorium mechanical ventilation system, Bayside International Exhibition Centre provides an auditorium air exchange rate of 6 ach during standard full-occupancy ventilation.
HSE-AIR-TGQ：According to the HVAC commissioning report evaluating the auditorium mechanical ventilation system, Metropolitan Expo and Conference Park demonstrates an auditorium air exchange rate of 8 ach under standard full-occupancy ventilation.
HSE-AIR-21R：The HVAC commissioning report for the auditorium mechanical ventilation system records that Cascade Pavilion and Arena Complex delivers an auditorium air exchange rate of 10 ach under standard full-occupancy ventilation.

information_points.title: Maintains pathogen containment protocols and hazardous clinical waste disposal accreditations（BIO）
information_points.content:
HSE-BIO-UPA：Based on the regional biosecurity compliance audit assessing the on-site medical and biological waste handling chain, Metropolitan Expo and Conference Park maintains accredited biosecurity waste protocol compliance under international clinical event standards.
HSE-BIO-AQ8：According to the regional biosecurity compliance audit of the on-site medical and biological waste handling chain, Bayside International Exhibition Centre holds accredited biosecurity waste protocol compliance under international clinical event standards.
HSE-BIO-660：The regional biosecurity compliance audit for the on-site medical and biological waste handling chain indicates that Cascade Pavilion and Arena Complex does not have accredited biosecurity waste protocol compliance under international clinical event standards.
